title: PQ 007 Gyau!!!! Super Soul provenance reconciliation
finding: The Super Soul endpoint metadata was correct, but canonical PQ reward/index coverage was incomplete.

evidence.finding: PQ 07 Attack of the Saiyans explicitly lists Gyau!!!! as a Basic Reward.
PQ 07 reward description independently lists Gyau!!!! and Shine Shot.

evidence.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki Super Soul catalogue
evidence.finding: The catalogue identifies Gyau!!!! as Super Soul 7 and lists Parallel Quest 07 as its acquisition.

correction: Added Gyau!!!! to the canonical PQ 7 Super Soul reward map, forward relationship layer, Super Soul acquisition index, unified reverse index, and crosslink projection.
note: Unlike Flying Nimbus!!, this endpoint should retain its PQ acquisition metadata because independent current catalogue and PQ reward evidence agree.
